notes.title: Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626403/cb4b8bfaee926f0dabd81bf904132a6d65e2864a.png[/img]

[b]Boom[/b] was supposed to be released as [b]Early Access[/b] yesterday. But it was unintentionally released without [b]Early Access[/b]. It was my mistake, but thanks to Steam support team, we were able to fix this issue. In meantime, you couldn't see "[b]Add to Cart[/b]" button in Steam store page because of this issue. Now it is on Early Access as it is supposed to be, and you can buy the game right now. I hope you enjoy playing this game. 

I can't wait to hear your feedback and your ideas!
